issues.detail: The Greek 'ανεζησεν' (lived forever/endured) is omitted or merged into the previous verb in the Vietnamese translation, losing the specific concept of eternal life.
The Greek 'κυριευση' (to have become Lord/to rule) is rendered as 'làm Chúa của' (to make/be the Lord of), which slightly shifts the active nature of the Greek verb into a state of being/possession.
